bio: Reigate Manor Hotel is a substantial Georgian manor house, situated in an unbeatably convenient location on the A217. As well as the ideal base for exploring the array of local walks and must see attractions within the Surrey Hills, it is the perfect venue to relax and enjoy a leisurely Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is available each day between 12pm and 5pm in the hotel lounge or garden terrace.  Comprising a truly scrumptious array of sweet and savoury, Afternoon Tea at Reigate Manor Hotel is most certainly a treat for the taste buds. Take a seat in the comfortable hotel lounge - the ideal setting to enjoy a relaxed catch up with a friend or loved one - and savour a delicious spread of fruit and plain scones with an indulgent topping of Cornish clotted cream and preserves, freshly made finger sandwiches, a selection of delicious cakes and mini desserts. Accompany the food with a freshly brewed pot of loose leaf tea or cafetiere coffee. Why not go one step further by adding a bit of sparkle to your Afternoon Tea with a glass of Prosecco or Champagne.  Reigate Manor is located in Surrey, just a few minutes’ drive from Junction 8 on the M25 and a short walk from Reigate town centre.
